name: s3SetMetaData
syntax: s3SetMetaData(bucketNameOrPath [, objectName], metadata [, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Sets the metadata of an S3 bucket or object.

params.name: bucketNameOrPath
params.description: The bucket name, or an `s3://` path to a bucket or object, such as `s3://mybucket/file.txt`.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The object key, when `bucketNameOrPath` is a bucket name.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.
